lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of larger spots in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed crossing the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct grid-like pattern where the nodes correspond to the white spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral) along its entire visible length.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated shape representing a commensal organism is visible near the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin itself exhibits a high-density pattern of varied-size high-luminance blobs.
